gaps.name: Deliverable handoff proof
gaps.residual_risk: A receipt still depends on the executor actually invoking it for promised artifacts.
gaps.next_hardening: Integrate receipt creation into artifact-producing workflows.

gaps.name: Interaction-level source coverage proof
gaps.residual_risk: Domain-specific source registries still control exact required-source membership.
gaps.next_hardening: Bind work-type templates to canonical source groups.

gaps.name: Capability-state truthfulness
gaps.residual_risk: Connector availability can change after receipt creation.
gaps.next_hardening: Refresh immediately before each material write.

gaps.name: Current UI verification
gaps.residual_risk: Some interfaces remain unobservable from the active environment.
gaps.next_hardening: Use current official documentation or explicitly mark unverified.

gaps.name: Notification freshness and deduplication
gaps.residual_risk: A changed fingerprint can still represent a semantically duplicate notice.
gaps.next_hardening: Add semantic topic keys and minimum material-change rules.

gaps.name: Immediate request alignment
gaps.residual_risk: Automated classification can mislabel mixed requests.
gaps.next_hardening: Permit multiple request modes with one explicitly primary mode.

gaps.name: Concise owner-facing closure report
gaps.next_hardening: Add audience-specific response budgets and exception reasons.

gaps.name: Automatic correction-to-regression intake
gaps.residual_risk: A correction may remain only in conversation unless manually converted.
gaps.next_hardening: Create a governed incident/correction intake command in a later work item.
